intent: Prepare v0.1.3 bookkeeping for merged PR #50 without changing product behavior, governance, component versions or upstream bytes.
selection_reason: Caller explicitly requested proportionate installed-only review of mechanical release bookkeeping. findings.title: Replace internal feed URLs with placeholders
findings.why_it_matters: New tracked release evidence embeds an organization-specific package-feed hostname in a public template. Authorization to use an internal feed locally does not authorize publishing its address.
evidence: .specify/memory/constitution.md, Supply-Chain & Licensing Constraints: Nothing specific to a single adopter, whether domain rules, hostnames, secrets, personal names or local paths, may appear in Baton.
docs/solutions/restricted-mirror-env-only-2026-09-29.md says docs, tests and batons should use placeholders such as <approved-package-index>.
Concrete organization-specific feed addresses occur in .baton/quick/release-013.md:124,144,187 and .baton/quick/release-013.work.json:33,63. Addresses are intentionally not repeated in this artifact.
The existing hostname test in test/unit/review-fix-docs.test.mjs scans docs, specs and baton, not these .baton additions.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace concrete internal-feed addresses in both records with approved-feed placeholders. Preserve environment-variable names, command outcomes, authorization and attempt history; verify no concrete internal hostname remains in these records.
findings.routing_reason: Caller forbids applying fixes; return the deterministic correction to the author without weakening or dismissing it.

findings.title: Refresh stale work-state narrative and next step
findings.why_it_matters: The read-first body says work is not persisted and directs ce-work despite authoritative frontmatter recording completed work and routing to review. Following the body risks an unnecessary work write and duplicate mandatory check.
evidence: Frontmatter records phase_completed: work, next_phase: review, next_owner: baton-review and status: ready.
local-checks-pass records 420 passed tests with zero failures/skips/cancellations; history records the successful work write at 2026-10-12T06:39:57.011Z.
.baton/quick/release-013.md:172 states phase work is not yet persisted; :195-196 prescribe /ce-work.
Historical failed attempts and prospective decisions do not invalidate the later successful receipt.
findings.suggested_fix: Refresh the current-state body to acknowledge the successful persisted work receipt and the actual next phase. Retain accurately labeled historical attempts and decisions.
findings.routing_reason: Caller forbids applying fixes; preserve the original candidate narrative and report its discrepancy.
